<SpecSection title="Scope" id="scope">
Runtime-level contracts for panic behavior, syscalls, IO, fiber scheduling, channels, and host-facing semantics.

Cooperative **fibers** and **Channel** synchronization are normative under **[Fiber scheduler and stacks](/platform-spec/execution/runtime/fiber-scheduler-and-stacks/)** and **[Channels and synchronization](/platform-spec/execution/runtime/channels-and-synchronization/)**. User APIs live in **[Concurrency package](/platform-spec/core-library/concurrency/concurrency-package/)**; preemptive **OS threads** live in **[System.Threading](/platform-spec/core-library/concurrency/system-threading/)**.
</SpecSection>
